title: Make exact frontier-pressure runs requestable by generic /wc workers
mission: Remove the repeated workflow_dispatch(source_sha) tool boundary from frontier-pressure verification without weakening exact-snapshot provenance. Add an append-only repository request lane that a generic authorized /wc can CREATE with one exact 40-hex source_sha; the existing Frontier Pressure Exact Snapshot workflow must consume that request on push, validate it, checkout exactly that SHA, run the existing regressions/compiler, and upload the same durable evidence. Preserve manual workflow_dispatch and fail closed on malformed/ambiguous requests.
definition_of_done: Define an append-only request schema/path such as coordination/portfolio/frontier-pressure-requests/<request_id>.json containing exact source_sha and non-authoritative request metadata.
.github/workflows/frontier-pressure-exact-snapshot.yml triggers on request-file creation and resolves source_sha from exactly one changed request file instead of substituting github.sha.
The workflow validates source_sha as exactly 40 hex, checks out that exact commit, verifies git rev-parse HEAD equals it, and runs the existing exact-snapshot executor/regressions unchanged.
Malformed request, zero/multiple changed request files, or missing source_sha fail closed before exact-snapshot claims.
Existing workflow_dispatch(source_sha) remains supported; existing self-test pushes for workflow/compiler/test paths remain supported.
Regression coverage proves a request targeting a historical SHA does not accidentally test the request commit HEAD.
Use the mechanism to request the previously blocked source_sha 1bcfbb91b1e5da0a4e26d364882e676a4127eb58 and persist run/job/artifact evidence, or return the exact remaining transport boundary.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w authority is promoted.
